# NumberEditLib:enableInstantChange

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Enable / disable the instant change (the value is only updated when the field losts the focus)

```lua
field:enableInstantChange(enabled)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.
